workbook.title: MIAT×QKI exact-footprint single-z analysis
workbook.subtitle: Processed nucleus, FOV, set-level, inference, correlation, representative-image, control, and QC tables
workbook.purpose: Consolidate final postrun CSV outputs into a readable, auditable workbook for dissertation and publication review.
workbook.interpretationGuard: Spatial colocalization is a pseudo-binding/association measurement and is not evidence of direct MIAT–QKI molecular binding.
workbook.analysisConvention: Exact MIAT detected footprints sampled on one reviewed z plane per FOV; the same z plane is used for DAPI, MIAT, and QKI.
workbook.provenance: All numerical source values are imported from postrun CSV files. Superplot helper values are formula-linked to the Set sheet.
readmeNotes: The q95 KEEP-N null call is primary; q90 and q99 are sensitivity thresholds.
Controls are QC-only and excluded from biological inference.
NT and KD sets are independent biological replicates; no NT1-to-KD1 pairing is implied.
FOVs and nuclei are nested observations; set-level summaries are the inferential unit.
Maximum-intensity projections are not used as inputs for colocalization measurements.
